name: shipyard
description: Take a consumer app from idea to store listing: research-first product discovery, an Expo + Next.js monorepo, Clerk auth, Postgres/Supabase with RLS, premium UI that avoids AI slop, onboarding and paywall conversion, RevenueCat/Stripe/Paystack money, localisation from day one, ASO and growth, observability, performance, cost control, store submission, and a self-review loop that runs on every slice.
